fields.notes: Fibre Channel does not ship a testbench, but the INCITS T11 standards imply a verification plan spanning FC-0..FC-2 (SerDes, encoding, framing, CRC, credit), login/addressing, classes of service, and the FC-4 mapping (FCP). Conformance follows the FC-FS / FC-LS / FC-SW / FC-GS / FCP standards.
verification_categories_derived_from_spe: FC-0/FC-1 SerDes + encoding (8b/10b <=8 GFC, 64b/66b >=16 GFC), word sync, running disparity.
Link initialization: NOS/OLS/LR/LRR primitive-sequence protocol to ACTIVE.
FC-AL loop init (LIP), AL_PA assignment, ARB/OPN/CLS.
32-bit CRC error injection -> discard -> ABTS recovery.
Sequence (SEQ_ID/SEQ_CNT) and exchange (OX_ID/RX_ID) handling; sequence initiative.
Flow control: BB_Credit (R_RDY) and EE_Credit (ACK), credit exhaustion.
Login: FLOGI 24-bit-address assignment, PLOGI/PRLI parameter negotiation.
Addressing: 24-bit Domain/Area/Port and well-known service addresses.
FC-4 FCP I/O: FCP_CMND/XFER_RDY/DATA/RSP, one exchange per I/O, TYPE=0x08.
Fabric services: Name Server discovery, RSCN.
